comparison.objective: Remove lint into a bin and slide a dryer lint screen back into its slot, versus commission an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cleaning and guided screen insertion; candidate requires hex-key seating, counterholding, fine collar rotation, tightening, and repeated impact inspection.
comparison.success_condition: Lint removed and screen reinserted; detailed tolerances are absent. Candidate requires two safe repeatable stops without bottoming or drift.
comparison.reason: Slot insertion is a shared generic manipulation primitive only; it does not reproduce adjustable damping or lock verification.
